_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Mixing up short and long i, and a, o

segments.text: Hit, Heat, Hat, Hot. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Hit, Heat, Hat, Hot.

native.hook: Hit, heat, hat, hot: qual é qual?
native.caption: “hit” e “heat” têm vogais diferentes, e “hat” e “hot” também. No “heat” a vogal é longa e os lábios se esticam; no “hit” ela é curta e relaxada. Olhe a boca do Carlos e repita na pausa. Pratique no app Lexkite.

en.hook: Hit, heat, hat, hot: which is which?
en.caption: “hit” and “heat” have different vowels, and so do “hat” and “hot”. In “heat” the vowel is long and your lips stretch; in “hit” it is short and relaxed. Watch Carlos’s mouth and repeat in the pause. Practice in the Lexkite app.
